facts.text: Cloud Migration Management page in the web client serves as the central hub for configuring and tracking data migration runs and services.
Data replication can be rerun after initial migration, moving only changes since the last run using change tracking.
User mapping renames the Name field on the User Card to match on-premises user names; perform this only once per migration.
Create diagnostic run to test data replication without migrating data, allowing issues to be identified and fixed first.
Reset cloud data clears all cloud tenant data and enables restarting the entire migration from the beginning.
Cloud migration cannot run if the target environment is undergoing upgrade; must disable it, upgrade, then reconfigure.
Setup checklist displays recommended steps to prepare tables not migrated for use as the primary system going live.
